about: Which custom node pack provides which node classes of the app graphs. Read by the page (missing-node message) and by scripts/check_install.py.
core_hint: This node is part of ComfyUI itself in recent versions: update ComfyUI to the latest release.

packs.name: MOTNGRFX (this pack)
packs.install: This pack is not loaded. Clone it into ComfyUI/custom_nodes, install requirements.txt, restart ComfyUI and read the console for an import error.
